intro_text: We're under contract. This is everything between now and closing, what's done and what's coming. I'll keep it updated as dates firm up, so check back whenever you want to know where things stand.

milestones.label: Agreed repairs completed
milestones.note: Dishwasher is the last open item. Hang on to receipts for anything that gets done.

milestones.label: Appraisal
milestones.note: The appraiser needs to get inside. Same prep as a showing works fine.

milestones.label: Buyer's loan approval
milestones.note: This one's on the buyer's lender. I'll update it as soon as I hear.

milestones.label: Utilities transferred out of your name
Buyer's final walkthrough
milestones.note: Usually the day of closing or the day before.

checklist_items: Schedule gas, electric, water, trash, and internet to come out of your name on Nov 2 (not before)
Set up mail forwarding with USPS
Keep homeowners insurance active through closing. Cancel it after, not before
Take everything that isn't staying with the house per the contract
Have the house professionally cleaned, including inside the oven, fridge, and all drawers
Leave all keys, garage door openers, and mailbox keys on the kitchen counter
Leave appliance manuals and any warranty paperwork in a kitchen drawer
Keep receipts for any repairs from the inspection resolution
Bring a photo ID to closing
Never act on wiring instructions sent by email. If anything about your proceeds changes, call the title company at a number you already have
note_text: Dates are estimates and can shift with lender, appraisal, and title timelines. I'll update this page as things move, so there's no need to track any of this yourself.
